correctness.rationale: Fu--Li--Wang--Wang reduce this rational continuous problem exactly to half the discrete Turán problem on \(\{0,\pm1,\pm4,\pm5,\pm6\}\). The package's primal polynomial is the normalized square of a cubic; exact Chebyshev expansion removes every forbidden frequency. The upper certificate uses its three real roots and positive Lagrange-residue weights whose moments at frequencies \(1,4,5,6\) all equal \(-1\); the degree-seven equation for \(a\) makes the final moment and objective equality exact. I independently solved the defining polynomial in the stated interval and reproduced \(a=0.533051836754696\ldots\) and \(\mathcal T_{\mathbb R}=2.135307178876396\ldots\). The inspected checker verifies the polynomial identities and all root/weight signs by exact rational interval arithmetic.
